en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a corner building labeled as an inn or guesthouse, a two‑storey structure with many windows and a tiled gabled roof. A lone person stands on the street in front. The lower image shows an elegant interior dining room with round and square tables covered with white cloths, wooden chairs, wall paneling, chandeliers, lamps, and a tiled stove. Between the images and below them is German cursive text giving the inn's name, proprietor, and description of the wine bar.
